notes.title: DLCs will be removed from the store.
notes.content:
Hello guys, I'm here to announce that I have decided to remove all the DLCs from the store. If you already own one or more DLCs the content from these DLCs will continue to be available for you.

After 2 years of feedback from the players (mostly negative) about the DLCs and after some considerations I have decided to remove it permanently from the store.

[b]The following games will be affected:[/b]

[h1]Andarilho:[/h1]
For the game Andarilho, the DLCs will be removed but, the content from it will be added to the game. If you own a DLC, you will receive one or more items on your Steam inventory relative to that DLC. A new update will be released soon and I will announce later all the changes and new items for the game.


[h1]Barro[/h1]
For Barro, the extra tracks will be available only for those who own the DLC and it will no longer be possible to buy it in the future.


[h1]Ninja Stealth[/h1]
For Ninja Stealth, the extra content was only cosmetic and it will be available only for those who already own the DLC.


[h1]Ninja Stealth 2[/h1]
Like Ninja Stealth, the extra content was only cosmetic and it will be available only for those who already own the DLC.


[h1]Ninja Stealth 3[/h1]
The extra levels and the laser customisation will be available only for those who already own the DLC. It doesn't interferes on the main game.


[b]The following DLCs will no longer be available for purchase:[/b]

ːns_redːAndarilho - Aliens
ːns_redːAndarilho - Guns
ːns_redːAndarilho - Vehicles
ːns_redːAndarilho - Zombies 

ːns_redːBarro - Track Pack 1
ːns_redːBarro - Track Pack 2

ːns_redːNinja Stealth - Supporter Edition 

ːns_redːNinja Stealth 2 - Golden Edition

ːns_redːNinja Stealth 3 - Custom Lasers
ːns_redːNinja Stealth 3 - Extra Levels #1



If you have any questions, feel free to contact me and I will be happy to help you.




SC Jogos

To be able to activate the achievements you will have to use the camouflage again for the achievement "I am Box" and enter the door in the first extra level again to activate the "Ninja" achievement.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: V.1.4.1
notes.content:
[b]V.1.4.1[/b]

[list]
[*]Now the Halloween event will be always available
[*]I had a few problems with the engine again, you may have to collect some of the cards again. Basically that's why I made Ninja Stealth 2 with RPG Maker..
[/list]



For some time people want to talk about the technical part of the game, god knows why and because of that I have made a gif with the collider of the Ninja so people can see and stop saying the character's collider is too large. The collider is the green line and that is where the detector will detect you when you are playing.
Before the detectors could detect a box being pushed in front of it too, but, I had to disabled that because apparently the players couldn't notice that and people kept complaining about some random detection.
So, now you can see how it works!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25250024/c42a53fa1cb66103d51fb5fb9540dbef722ce39e.gif[/img]


I hope you enjoy this small update and do not forget to check the Ninja Stealth 2 on Greenlight...

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=831467074

For some time people want to talk about the technical part of the game, god knows why and because of that I have made a gif with the collider of the Ninja so people can see and stop saying the character's collider is too large. The collider is the green line and that is where the detector will detect you when you are playing.
Before the detectors could detect a box being pushed in front of it too, but, I had to disabled that because apparently the players couldn't notice that and people kept complaining about some random detection.
So, now you can see how it works!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25250024/c42a53fa1cb66103d51fb5fb9540dbef722ce39e.gif[/img]


I hope you enjoy this small update and do not forget to check the Ninja Stealth 2 on Greenlight...

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=831467074

notes.title: V.1.4.0
notes.content:
[h1]V.1.4.0:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now you can play using your keyboard or a gamepad, just set it on the initial screen before the game starts. However, you still need to use the mouse to access the menus.

[*] End of lives. A common request was to change the lives system, initially were added more lives for the player, but as the amount of lives was high, they were removed from the game completly.

[*] Now you have to collect all computers in the levels, without them you will not be able to enter the final level.

[*] The Halloween update will no longer be available, only next year.

[*] New content available. The DLC "Ninja Stealth A.I. Revolution" will be launched on this November 9th with 20 additional levels for the game.
[/list]


[h1]Keys:[/h1]
[list]
[*] W-A-S-D: to move the character
[*] E: is the action button, you can activate the camouflage with it for exemple.
[*] ESC: cancel or to open the menu in the game
[*] Space or Enter: confirm
[/list]


[b]Note:[/b] You can change the keys on the tab "Input" on the configutration screen before the game opens.

notes.title: V.1.0.0 - Full release
notes.content:
[h1]The beginning:[/h1]
[list]
The game had 6 levels and the initial goal was to improve these levels and make a few changes.
[/list]

[h1]The Early access:[/h1]
[list]
During the EA I decided to rewrite the entire game to make it better because I had to many problems with the detection. 
I added new levels and new mechanics to the game.
The achievements wasn't planned, but the community suggested to add it and I decided to do it.
[/list]

[h1]The final result:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now we have:
[*]25 levels
[*]5 extra levels (they will unlock when you finish the game)
[*]New mechanics that wasn't available before, like the camouflage
[*]30 achievements
[/list]

[h1]The future:[/h1]
[list]
There is no reason to stay on EA anymore. So, the game now go to full release, that doesn't mean the game will not have new updates,  I will update it further and from time to time I will add new content to it.
[/list]


Thank you guys for the help during the EA and if you have any suggestion feel free to use the forum to let us know.
